notes: Country determination: Germany (Leipzig 'L' license plate on Opel in photo 8, EN 840 wheelie bins with German labels in photo 1, German-style green garden fence, 1920s/30s clinker-and-stucco villa architecture). Certainty: high. Calc profile DE.

Building age pre-1950 (clinker quoins, Reichsformat bricks, historic entry door): door-based scale chains treated as statistical per DE rule and cross-checked against brick coursing (Reichsformat, ~78 mm course incl. joint).

Yaw estimates: photo 5 ~5 deg, photo 8 ~3 deg (near frontal); photo 7 ~5 deg; photo 1 ~40 deg (corrected for depth chain); photo 6 ~55 deg (corrected, low reliability); photos 2/3 steeply angled, used for local detail only.
Photo 7 was triaged as 'front' but clearly shows the garden (back) elevation: balcony, winter-garden window band, dormers, exterior steel stair. Treated as back.
Facade corners in photos 5 and 8 lie near the outer 10% of the frame; wide-angle distortion may compress corners - width chains carry extra uncertainty.
Front grade line occluded by fence and vehicles in photos 5/8; grade assumed at fence/step base.
Site slopes down toward the garden (back) by roughly 600 mm relative to street grade.
